message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。建議您可以參考以下幾個可靠來源來取得美國今日黃金價格：

1. **Bloomberg** – https://www.bloomberg.com/markets/commodities  
2. **Reuters** – https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities  
3. **Kitco** – https://www.kitco.com/  
4. **美聯儲或美國商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）** 的官方網站，通常也會提供黃金期貨價格資訊。

這些網站都會以實時或近乎實時的方式更新黃金價格，您可以直接查看「Gold」或「XAU/USD」等相關行情。
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide an answer. We don't have real-time data. We can say we don't have real-time data. But maybe we can approximate or say we can't fetch. According to policy, we should not fabricate. So we should respond that we don't have real-time data. Possibly we can suggest checking reliable sources.
